{"summary":"Successfully integrated Ethiopian 2026 public holidays into the compliance engine.

**Changes made to `compliance-engine.interface.ts`:**
- Added `PublicHoliday` interface with fields: `date`, `name`, `nameAmharic`, `type`
- Added `date?: string` optional field to `OvertimeCalculationInput` for holiday detection
- Added `ETHIOPIAN_HOLIDAYS_2026` constant array with 12 Ethiopian holidays:
  - New Year's Day (Jan 1)
  - Ethiopian Christmas/Timkat (Jan 7, Jan 19)
  - Eid al-Fitr & Eid al-Adha (Islamic holidays)
  - Good Friday & Easter Orthodox (April)
  - Ethiopian Patriots Day (May 5)
  - Derg Downfall Day (May 28)
  - Ethiopian New Year/Enkutatash (Sep 1)
  - Meskel Day (Sep 2)
  - Adwa Victory Day (Mar 2)
  - Labor Day (May 1)

**Changes made to `compliance-engine.ts`:**
- Added `HOLIDAYS_2026` private property
- Added `getHolidayForDate(dateStr)` - returns holiday info for a given date
- Added `isPublicHoliday(dateStr)` - checks if a date is a holiday
- Added `getPublicHolidays()` - returns all 12 holidays
- Added `calculateOvertimeWithHolidayDetection(input)` - auto-detects holidays and applies 2.5x multiplier
